description: This Java source file defines the UtilCacheEvents class, which contains static methods to handle HTTP requests related to cache management operations such as removing elements, clearing caches, and updating cache configurations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages cache interactions and permissions checks and contributes to the web tools module for cache event handling.

classes.name: UtilCacheEvents
classes.description: Contains static HTTP request handling methods for cache management, including removing, clearing, and updating cache entries within the OFBiz webtools framework.

methods.name: removeElementEvent
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request to remove a specific element from a named cache, with permission checks and error handling.

methods.name: clearEvent
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request to clear a specified cache, with security permission validation.

methods.name: clearAllEvent
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request to clear all caches, with security permission validation.

methods.name: clearSelectedCachesEvent
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request to clear multiple selected caches, processing form data and permission validation.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request to update cache settings such as max in-memory size, expiration time, and soft references, with permission checking.
